definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is generous and open-handed, especially with money. Can be used as a noun (a generous person) or as a na-adjective (generous).

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}だ。
{太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}な⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奢|おご}って⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食事代|しょくじだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He is big-hearted and always pays for his subordinates' meals.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used to describe someone who is generous with money, particularly someone who willingly pays for others or gives lavishly. Carries a positive, admiring nuance. Can function as both a noun and a na-adjective.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a generous person)
- {太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}だ (is generous)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}な⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧ (a generous boss)
- {太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奢|おご}る (to treat generously)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気前|きまえ}がいい→気前がいい：20378_kimaegaii⟧: generous, open-handed (more everyday)
- ⟦{寛大|かんだい}→寛大：15278_kandai⟧: magnanimous, tolerant (broader, not just about money)
